description: Serratus anterior fans along the ribs with finger-like slips that drive scapular glide and help lock the shoulder to the thorax for expressive reaches.
actions: Protracts the scapula to sweep it around the rib cage, broadening the back for powerful punches and reaches.
Upwardly rotates the scapula in concert with the trapezius to free the arm for overhead gestures.
Stabilizes the scapula against the thorax, preventing winging during weight-bearing on the upper limb.
